description: Merchant-Backend: Create GET /settlement-config/requests endpoint for merchants to view their pending and historical approval requests.
steps: 1. Create /Users/mathew/Merchant-Backend/src/main/java/com/tms/report/modules/settlement/dto/ApprovalRequestResponse.java: DTO for approval request listing. Fields with @JsonProperty: Long id, @JsonProperty("user_id") Long userId, String section, String status, String description, String payload, @JsonProperty("reject_reason") String rejectReason, @JsonProperty("created_at") LocalDateTime createdAt, @JsonProperty("approved_at") LocalDateTime approvedAt, @JsonProperty("rejected_at") LocalDateTime rejectedAt, @JsonProperty("executed_at") LocalDateTime executedAt. Use Lombok @Data, @Builder, @NoArgsConstructor, @AllArgsConstructor.

2. Add method to SettlementApprovalService: List<ApprovalRequestResponse> getApprovalRequests(Long merchantId). Implements native query: SELECT id, user_id, section, status, description, payload, reject_reason, created_at, approved_at, rejected_at, executed_at FROM supermerchant.pending_approvals WHERE user_id = :merchantId AND action_type = 'settlement_config' ORDER BY created_at DESC. Map results to ApprovalRequestResponse DTOs.

3. Add endpoint to SettlementConfigController: @GetMapping("/requests") @Transactional(readOnly = true) public ApiResponse<List<ApprovalRequestResponse>> getRequests() { Get merchantId from MerchantScope; call service.getApprovalRequests(merchantId); return ApiResponse.success(results); }

4. Add method to SettlementApprovalService: boolean hasPendingRequest(Long merchantId, String section). Query: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM supermerchant.pending_approvals WHERE user_id = :merchantId AND section = :section AND status = 'pending'. This enables the UI to show whether a pending request exists.
acceptance_criteria: ApprovalRequestResponse DTO has all fields needed to display approval status to merchants
GET /settlement-config/requests returns list of merchant's approval requests ordered by created_at DESC
hasPendingRequest method correctly checks for existing pending requests
All queries are scoped to the authenticated merchant's user_id
